Linial, *The influence of variables on Boolean functions*, FOCS 1988; this proof follows D. Falik, A. Samorodnitsky, *Edge-isoperimetric inequalities and influences*, 2007): `2 · ∑_{S ≠ ∅} f̂(S)² · log (1 / maxₑ Infₑ) ≤ ∑_S 4 |S| f̂(S)²` for every Boolean function.
